content.short: rewrx is a community-focused information and rewards hub providing updates and tools for Cardano builders.
content.description: rewrx is a dedicated information and rewards platform within the Cardano ecosystem, designed to support both builders and creators. The project serves as a central hub for 'Sessions,' providing in-depth updates on network developments, such as the Midnight protocol and the NIGHT token. By offering visibility and professional tools for new initiatives, rewrx helps high-quality projects reach a wider audience. Its mission is to foster a collaborative environment where participation is rewarded and the community stays informed about the latest innovations and opportunities on the blockchain.
content.meta: rewrx is a Cardano information and rewards hub covering ecosystem sessions, project updates, and builder visibility. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
